hooks.command: d="$HOME/.zcode/z-quota-watch/state/count"; mkdir -p "$d" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; s="$CLAUDE_SESSION_ID"; [ -n "$s" ] || s=default; k=$(printf %s "$s" | tr -cd 'A-Za-z0-9._-'); [ -n "$k" ] || k=default; f="$d/$k.count"; n=$(($(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)+1)); if [ "$n" -gt 20 ]; then echo 0 >"$f" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; exec node "${ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/zqw.js" hook pre-tool-use; fi; echo "$n" >"$f" 2>/dev/null; exit 0
